storySteps.title: Open the first refugee-camp well and tent projects
Build the first well and tent and open City I's second tier
Open City I's garden and second tent and reach the refugee target
Reach seven refugees and optionally automate City I's well
Complete City I and receive Teodoro's first camp reward
Report to Teodoro and open City II's first three builds
Upgrade the depot and campfire, build tent six, and open City II's second tier
Build tent seven and Teodoro's workplace and optionally hear the eleven-refugee request
Reach eleven refugees and arm City II's finale
Complete City II and schedule its downstream raid gate
Report the guard raid and open City III's perimeter fence
Build City III's fence, sword rack, and observation tower
Complete City III and prepare the guard ambush when eligible
